evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection management in src/net.cpp and message handling in src/net_processing.cpp to enforce BIP324 v2 transport on clearnet.
rationale: Adds the `-v2onlyclearnet` option to prevent cleartext message leakage and passive ISP surveillance over opportunistic v1 fallback connections. As noted in issue #29618 and supported across multiple reviews, this provides a durable privacy and transport-security capability for node runners now that BIP324 adoption is sufficiently widespread.
